maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is commissions on new and renewal home and auto policies sold through franchised agencies, not repair or servicing of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are households and individuals buying home, auto and bundled personal insurance; commissions come from private carriers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by franchising agencies and expanding its own agent network and policy sales, not by buying companies.

mission_critical.reason: Personal-lines insurance agency shopping 150+ carriers; customers can switch agents or carriers fairly easily, with little downtime.
